name: Tabelo
tagline: Edit one table visually or as text, entirely in your browser.
description: A table editor where the grid and the text formats stay in sync: Markdown, CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML and Jira. Everything runs locally as a PWA, so no table you paste ever leaves your machine.

image.alt: Tabelo showing the same table as Markdown text on the left and as an editable grid on the right

name: Moon Uniform
tagline: An open font family for the Moon tactile alphabet.
description: Moon is the raised alphabet William Moon published in 1845 for people who lose their sight later in life. This font draws the script, applies the historical short-form rules to plain English through OpenType features, and cites a source for every sign. Three weights, a dot-matrix variant for embossers, and a specimen with a type tester.

image.alt: The words Moon Uniform set in the Moon tactile alphabet, green on cream

name: WindowHop
tagline: Switch between windows, not just apps, on macOS.
description: A native macOS window switcher with large app icons or live previews, bound to a keyboard shortcut. Free, GPL-licensed, no telemetry. Built because Command-Tab switches apps and I wanted to switch windows.

image.alt: WindowHop's switcher with a grid of window previews and their app icons

name: Issues Graph
tagline: See the blocking order of a GitHub backlog as a graph.
description: Reads issue dependencies through the GitHub API and lays them out as a directed graph in the browser, with nothing installed in the repository being read. Useful for finding what to unblock first.

image.alt: A dependency graph of GitHub issues drawn as connected cards

name: Mailbell
tagline: Gmail notifications in the macOS menu bar, with no server in between.
description: Instant IMAP IDLE alerts for Gmail, a review queue you can clear in one click, and OAuth with PKCE stored in the Keychain. The app talks to Gmail directly; nothing of yours passes through anyone else's machine.

image.alt: Mailbell's app icon, a white bell on a yellow rounded square

name: Small Lights
tagline: Forty points of light drift, bond, age and speak in a dark field.
description: An ambient agent-based simulation on a canvas: the lights move, form bonds, grow old and occasionally say something through the Web Speech API. No build, no dependencies, one HTML file.

image.alt: Small points of light drifting across a dark field

name: Meantime
tagline: World clocks in the macOS menu bar, with time travel.
description: Scheduled clocks, a quick calendar, and a slider that moves every clock at once so you can find a meeting time across time zones without arithmetic. Native, fast and private.

image.alt: Meantime's menu bar panel with two city clocks and a calendar

name: Orbit
tagline: Google Contacts, grouped by place, on the iPhone.
description: A personal iOS app for managing Google Contacts: import Apple Contacts into Google, group people by city and country, and search a fast local-first cache of everyone you know. Built for my own address book and not published.

image.alt: Orbit's app icon, two overlapping white circles on green

name: Atlas Tint
tagline: An interactive SVG atlas for colouring and tracking regions of the world.
description: Select countries and regions, give them colours, and keep the result locally. Built on D3 and TopoJSON with keyboard navigation for every region, because a map you can only use with a mouse is only half a map.

name: Todo Print Editor
tagline: Design and print to-do lists as exact-size A4 layouts.
description: A visual or Markdown editor for structured checklists that prints exactly as laid out, offline, with the layout stored on your machine. For people who still like paper.

name: Country Badge Generator
tagline: Downloadable SVG, PNG and JPG country badges from flag colours.
description: Pick a country, get a badge with one of three deterministic, flag-inspired backgrounds, and download it in the format you need. Plain JavaScript, no build step, tested end to end with Playwright.

name: GitHub Blog
tagline: A blog whose posts are GitHub issues.
description: Shows a GitHub profile and its posts, where each post is an issue in a repository: the title is the issue title and the body is the post. Markdown rendering, search, and nothing to host.

name: Budget Control
tagline: A simple tracker for income and expenses.
description: Log transactions, watch the balance, and search what you spent. A study project on forms, context and derived state in React.

name: Coffee Delivery
tagline: An online coffee shop with a cart and checkout flow.
description: Browse a curated coffee menu, customise an order, and check out. A study project on shopping-cart state, forms with validation and styled-components.

name: Catalogue of Languages
tagline: Every documented language in the Wikitongues database, in one table.
description: An interactive table for exploring the world's linguistic diversity, fed by the Wikitongues Airtable base. A side project born from a hobby.

name: Pomodoro Timer
tagline: A focus timer with a history of what you worked on.
description: Start a cycle, name the task, and keep a log of finished and interrupted sessions. A study project on React context, forms with Zod and styled-components.

name: React To-Do List
tagline: Add, complete and delete tasks, in TypeScript.
description: A small to-do list built to practise componentisation, props, state and immutability in React with TypeScript.

name: Community Feed
tagline: A social feed with comments and applause.
description: Simulates a social media feed with commenting, applauding and deleting comments. Built with Vite to practise hooks, state and immutability, with Jest tests.

name: KeyForge
tagline: Generate and evaluate passwords in Node.js.
description: A library for generating cryptographically secure passwords with customisable options, plus a function that scores the strength of an existing one. Published on npm.

name: Angular To-Do List
tagline: A to-do app with an Express back end.
description: Add, edit, complete and delete tasks, with Angular Material for the UI and a small Node and Express API behind it. Built to practise components, services, routing and forms in Angular.

name: Angular Calendar
tagline: A calendar built from scratch with Angular Material and CDK.
description: Month view, events, and drag interactions written by hand on top of Angular's component kit, without a calendar library.

name: Svelte Calculator
tagline: The iPhone calculator, rebuilt in Svelte.
description: Same layout, same behaviour, a different framework. A weekend project to try Svelte.

name: Bézier Curves
tagline: Draw Bézier curves with the mouse.
description: An interactive canvas for placing control points and watching the curve follow, built for a computer graphics course at CIn-UFPE with p5.js.

name: Survive
tagline: An audio game about staying alive after the end of the world.
description: Played entirely by ear: a narrator describes the situation and the player chooses. No graphics, so it works for people who cannot see the screen, which was the point.

name: Proffy
tagline: Connecting teachers and students, on the web and on the phone.
description: A web and mobile app for finding a teacher and booking a class, built during Rocketseat's Next Level Week for Brazil's Day of Education Professionals.

name: Investments Dashboard
tagline: The stock market's biggest moves, at a glance.
description: A plain dashboard for tracking the largest market fluctuations, key indices and favourite assets, made for people who want a quick daily look rather than a trading terminal.

name: Simple JavaScript Games
tagline: Bouncing balls, Take the Color, and other small games.
description: A collection of small browser games written while learning JavaScript, jQuery and p5.js. Where a lot of this started.

name: Course exercises
tagline: Clones, to-do lists and API demos from front-end courses.
description: Exercises from Digital House, Digital Innovation One and PUC Minas: a Twitter login clone, a Netflix home page, a CEP search, a Snake game, a movie search, an iFood clone in React Native, and more. Kept here as a record.
